rule.title: An HSA or MSA distribution used for qualified medical expenses or rolled over is not taxable

citation.wording: An HSA or Archer MSA distribution isn't taxable if you used it to pay qualified medical expenses of the account holder or eligible family member or you rolled it over.

rule.open_point: A partly qualified distribution's taxable amount is Form 8889 Part II / Form 8853 arithmetic; box 1 then counts as printed. The additional 20% tax is a computation.
